name: Ochi (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ochi town emblem in white: an outlined trefoil of three leaf-like lobes.
history: Municipal flag of Ochi, a town in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Ochi town emblem — an outlined trefoil of three leaf-like lobes
